units.source_text: 此次浮舟竟破例地拿起信来看了。

en.t: This time, Ukifune unexpectedly broke with her usual habit and picked up the letter to read it.

units.source_text: 她正当感伤之时，看到中将绝望的语气，更添哀怜之情。

en.t: Already overcome with sadness, she saw the despair in the Captain's words and felt her pity deepen even more.

units.source_text: 此时她不知怎么一想，就在一小片纸的一端写道：

en.t: Then, moved by some sudden thought, she wrote on one end of a small scrap of paper:
